{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/profiles.py:8:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:9:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:10:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:15:test-failure"], "search": "    bio: Optional[str]
    website: Optional[str]
    age: Optional[int]", "replace": "    bio: Optional[str] = None
    website: Optional[str] = None
    age: Optional[int] = None", "explanation": "In Pydantic v2, a field annotated `Optional[T]` with no default is required (migration.md#required-optional-and-nullable-fields). Adding `= None` restores the v1 behavior of an implicit None default. This also fixes the test failure at line 15: profile_from_form drops empty and None form values, so omitted bio/website/age were previously missing-field errors. With defaults in place, the function body is unchanged and works as in v1."}], "notes": "Single edit covers the three optional-no-default findings. The test-failure at line 15 (profile_from_form) is a symptom of the same root cause: the function filters out blank values, so the omitted Optional fields must have defaults. Fixing the model fixes it, so profile_from_form needs no change. Not changed: `interests: List[str] = []` already has a default and is valid in v2 (mutable defaults are copied per instance by pydantic). The `Profile` class is a Pydantic BaseModel, so the edit is in scope. No import changes are needed because `Optional` is already imported."}
